name: Set Them Ablaze!
summary: In Searing Gorge, you carry Maltrake’s torch to the four sentry towers. Its flames cannot be subdued, and the towers cannot be destroyed. While they burn, guards and sentries abandon their posts, leaving the Dark Irons without their first line of defense.

sections.title: A Fire No Force Can Subdue
sections.body: The Torch of Retribution burns beyond the power of any element or force to subdue. Maltrake sends you into each of the four sentry towers, North, South, East and West, to use it within the walls. Dark Iron lookouts keep watch there, so Maltrake warns you to beware.

sections.title: After the Last Flame
sections.body:
When you return to Maltrake after the last tower burns, he cries out in triumph to his master. Velarok the Deceiver answers, revealing himself as a drake of the black dragonflight. His plan has worked perfectly, he gloats, because you would never have aided the Blackrock legion if they had simply asked.

Maltrake wonders what to do with you, but Velarok silences him. You will live to watch the Blackrock legion invade the gorge. Velarok has Maltrake hand over trinkets, speaks of a molt, then flies toward the gorge.

faq.q: Who sends you to set the towers ablaze?
faq.answer: Squire Maltrake sends you to the towers and gives you the Torch of Retribution.
Enter and ignite the four sentry towers: North, South, East and West.

faq.q: Why use the Torch of Retribution instead of tearing down the towers?
faq.answer: The towers cannot be destroyed. The Torch of Retribution keeps them burning for ages, and no element or force can subdue its flames.

faq.q: What was the previous step before this one?
faq.answer: You spoke with Squire Maltrake, who then gave you this undertaking.
